currentManifest.title: 会議、聞いてます？ ～MEETING SURVIVAL～
currentManifest.subtitle: その提案、まだ決まっていません。
core_mechanic: 3 authored agendas then optional deeper correction agenda
currentManifest.duration_note: Text shows3.8–7seconds based on length; authored reading time about25seconds per agenda is a design hypothesis; human comprehension unmeasured
currentManifest.primary_score: 100 per correct field +100 complete agenda +30 actual correction response +20 per complete streak;25 per unique irrelevant recording
currentManifest.secondary_score: completed agendas, correct fields, correction responses
currentManifest.escalation_mechanic: After3 agendas bank score freely or accept one authored rollback/conditional/multi-correction agenda without speeding text.
currentManifest.risk_reward: Two major failures end the meeting; one incorrect field allows learning and continuing. Ask twice per agenda with no score penalty.
currentManifest.visual_identity: existing generated speaker portraits with consistent neutral cards, readable dialogue and simultaneous3-field minutes

required_actions: submit correct minutes without recording proposal or chat
